## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any compatibility implications.

## Verification

List commands and results, meaningful regressions covered, and any checks that could not run.

## Review

- [ ] Public APIs, stored formats, configuration defaults, and platform behavior were considered.
- [ ] Relevant failure paths, ownership, input limits, and evidence preservation were reviewed.
- [ ] Tests and documentation reflect the change; no checks were weakened.
- [ ] Fixtures and diagnostics use synthetic data and contain no credentials or private repository contents.
